card.title: Ask Me About the Process
card.instruction: Create opportunities to display your knowledge of obscure rules, customs, and procedures. Correct small details before anyone can praise the outcome.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Before you thank me for getting the leak fixed, it's a formal representation, not a complaint letter.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: All right. Your representation got us a plumber.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: An emergency attendance. The regional salutation puts it in that category.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Help me file the receipt, then. What should I call the folder?

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Emergency attendances, plural. Leave room for a note explaining how my salutation secured this one.
